purpose: Labeled sentiment eval set for Feature F4. Single messages carry an ideal emotion label; escalation_scenarios carry multi-turn sequences with an expected escalate decision. Separate from the frozen quality golden set and NOT frozen (may grow as edge cases surface).
labels_note: Emotion labels: calm | confused | frustrated | angry. Controls (control field): emphatic_calm = loud-but-POSITIVE; positive = resolved/grateful; sarcasm = frustration expressed sarcastically (ideal label reflects the real feeling). The LOAD-BEARING metric is false-escalation on the no-escalate controls (calm/confused/emphatic_calm/positive), the F2 no-false-green applied to emotion.
leakage_guard_note: Eval messages must not near-copy a sentiment prototype (sentiment_eval.py fails on normalized string match OR cosine >= 0.90), so accuracy measures generalization.
escalation_note: Single messages should NOT escalate (escalation requires SUSTAINED frustration via the EMA), EXCEPT explicit profanity (a high-precision abuse override). Multi-turn escalation is measured by escalation_scenarios.
